description: The invoice's own payment address for your checkout page: the payer sends `amount` of `asset` on `network` (plus `memo` when set) before `expires_at`; the invoice is paid by itself once it arrives. A repeat call returns the same address and never extends the window. Show the amount, the network and the deadline from the answer UNCHANGED. Money comes IN only. 409 `checkout_disabled` while the app's address payment method is off.

asset.description: Asset the payer sends, e.g. USDT.

name: getInvoiceAddress
